trends.name: Iran-Israel Escalation & Market Impact
trends.summary: Israel struck Iran's steel factories, power plants, and nuclear sites in coordination with the U.S., contradicting Trump's 10-day diplomatic pause. The S&P 500 has lost $4.5 trillion in market cap since Iran tensions began Feb 28th. Geopolitical risk is driving broad equity selloff and anxiety across income levels.

trends.name: Energy Crisis & Oil Supply Surge
trends.summary: Oil prices hit highest levels since 2022 as Iran negotiations fail and Strait of Hormuz restrictions loom. Supply fears override Trump's 10-day pause, with crude continuing higher despite diplomatic efforts. Energy stocks and commodities now leading flight-to-safety trades.

trends.name: U.S. Treasury Market Stress
trends.summary: Weakest Treasury auctions in 3+ years as Iran war anxiety grows; yields surging globally including UK gilts as BOE hike expectations rise. Bond market dysfunction signals escalating financial stress and potential spillover to equity valuations.

trends.name: SpaceX IPO & Retail Investor Access
trends.summary: Elon Musk targeting retail investors for up to 30% of SpaceX IPO shares, breaking traditional institutional dominance. Major shift in how mega-cap private companies access public markets, with implications for wealth redistribution and market structure.

trends.name: Houthi Retaliation & Shipping Threats
trends.summary: Yemen-based Houthi military announcing imminent statement following Israel-Iran escalation. Risk of expanded regional attacks on shipping and infrastructure; critical supply chain vulnerability in Red Sea and global trade corridors.

trends.name: Government Shutdown & TSA Disruptions
trends.summary: House Republicans rejected Senate DHS funding deal; government shutdown cripples airport TSA operations and travel. Despite some operational efficiencies noted, public safety concerns mount as negotiations extend shutdown through potential impacts on economic activity.

trends.name: Stock Market Valuation Reset Underway
trends.summary: P/E multiples contracting sharply as geopolitical risk forces repricing of growth stocks. Citi maintains S&P 500 target but market won't bottom until sellside cuts year-end forecasts. Extended pullback creating buying opportunities as earnings estimates face downward pressure.

trends.name: Oracle Credit Stress & Corporate Debt Risk
trends.summary: Oracle's credit default swaps approaching 2008 financial crisis closing levels, signaling severe corporate credit stress. Warns of broader leverage concerns across mega-cap tech and signals potential contagion in corporate bond markets.

trends.name: Crypto Sector Capitulation & Recovery Buy
trends.summary: Ethereum slips under $2,000 as staking trade cools; meanwhile Strategy is accelerating crypto purchases as rivals pause. Sector showing bifurcated sentiment with institutional buyers stepping in at lows despite retail capitulation.

trends.name: Biotech & Gene Therapy Catalysts
trends.summary: Rocket Pharmaceuticals received FDA approval for KRESLADI gene therapy; Autolus and Maze Therapeutics advancing despite stock declines. Rare disease and autoimmune treatments driving long-term sector value despite near-term volatility.

trends.name: Trump Policy Shifts & Market Influence Waning
trends.summary: Questions mounting on Trump's influence over stock market as sustained declines persist despite pro-business rhetoric. E15 fuel announcement and economic speech in Miami show continued policy activity but markets unresponsive to executive signaling.

trends.name: IRS Tax Refunds & Consumer Liquidity
trends.summary: Average IRS tax refunds up 10.9% as 1.4M filers face delays amid paper check phaseout. Liquidity boost for consumers but bottleneck in payment processing could impact March-April consumer spending patterns and economic momentum.
